checks.comparison: rounds selects K for literal and K-1 for prefix. advance is called after initialization and after each completed collector; it halts exactly when the completed iteration reaches rounds. Both modes retain the selector from Fin(max1K), and record every eligible x_j at its creation. For K=1 prefix stops after full initialization, while literal computes x1 and its final estimator before halting; both return x0. For K>1 the prefix completes K-1 rounds and already contains all K eligible output points. Literal retains the extra source round. Equality of point laws and the different clock bounds are not assumed by these definitions and must be proved later.

Initialization starts a full collector at x0 and sets the selected point to x0. Its completion installs g0 before advance computes x1=x0-eta*g0. Each advance uses refresh bit at the old iteration, creates a new full or (xnext,xold) difference collector using the next batch row, and preserves old g until completion. Full completion replaces g; difference completion adds the scaled difference to old g. Selection records x_j when the independent Fin(max1K) index equals j. For valid K>0 this chooses exactly x0,...,x(K-1), never the final xK. The state carries actual completion clocks and global job IDs; a new collector resets pending work. Correct collector values, fresh completed samples and execution correspondence remain separate proofs.

Initialization starts a full collector at x0 and sets the selected point to x0. Its completion installs g0 before advance computes x1=x0-eta*g0. Each advance uses refresh bit at the old iteration, creates a new full or (xnext,xold) difference collector using the next batch row, and preserves old g until completion. Full completion replaces g; difference completion adds the scaled difference to old g. Selection records x_j when the independent Fin(max1K) index equals j. For valid K>0 this chooses exactly x0,...,x(K-1), never the final xK. The state carries actual completion clocks and global job IDs; a new collector resets pending work. Correct collector values, fresh completed samples and execution correspondence remain separate proofs. Before dispatch it tests rounds<=iteration. Otherwise new IDs start at the preceding collector nextID, then the state reserves n initial IDs. Selection updates only the selected field; the selector does not affect the query or algorithm recurrence.
